sourceText:
Easy Ground Turkey Shu Mai
By: Zomppa
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 5:22am

Ingredients




1 pound ground turkey (or chicken)
8 small shrimp (peeled, chopped into pieces)
1/2 tablespoon ginger, chopped
1/2 tablespoon scallion, minced
1 tablespoon sesame oil
2 tablespoons soy sauce
Pepper
1/4 teaspoon chicken bouillon
1/2 tablespoon corn starch
1/2 tablespoon egg
Salt
Wonton wrappers (round)

Preparation

1 Mix everything together in food processor and put in the refrigerator for 20 minutes; 2 Put about one tablespoon of filling in each wrapper. Wet the wrapper and gather up the sides and twist, leaving the center open. 3 Place lettuce leaves for parchment paper in bamboo steamers. Steam for about 8-10 minutes until done. 4 Optional: garnish with sesame seeds or finely minced chives

About


I love dim sum. LOVE it! But I never could quite figure out how to make the little packages…they look so dainty and scrumptious. So I gave the famous shu mai a try. Shu mai are typically steamed pork and shrimp tucked in thin wrappers. I tried mine with ground turkey. It was far easier than I had imagined so thought I would share!
